text.en:
Reloading after scoring Kills with the weapon overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored. 

Tarrabah overfills the next magazine by 20% per kill scored, up to a maximum of 150% Base Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up. 

Kill counter persists through stow.
